name: Mohamed Rashidh
about_me: I own AI systems end to end, from architecture to production: I've designed and deployed two production AI agents for an Abu Dhabi government entity, and I architect the multi-LLM orchestration, RAG and ERP-integration layers that management, finance and customer-support teams rely on daily. I take a business problem, decide the architecture, build it, integrate it with the systems the organization already runs — ERP, commerce, telephony, email — and keep it reliable in production. First-class B.Sc. (Hons) in Computer Science & Software Engineering, University of Bedfordshire.
projectExplanation: A selection of the AI agents, backend systems and products I've taken from idea to production — for an Abu Dhabi government entity, for the business I work inside today, and for myself.

impact.label: Production AI agents delivered for an Abu Dhabi government entity
Stores unified under one merchant admin
LLM providers orchestrated behind one API

agentic_systems.title: Multi-LLM Orchestration
agentic_systems.description: One API in front of OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini and more — with model switching, fallback handling, centralised tool execution and message compaction that kills context-overflow errors and cuts token costs.

agentic_systems.title: RAG & Knowledge Bases
agentic_systems.description: Retrieval-augmented knowledge bases that re-index updated documents automatically, so production agents stay current on live data without a redeploy.

agentic_systems.title: MCP Servers & Tool Calling
agentic_systems.description: MCP servers and function-calling layers that let admin users make real changes — to a store, an ERP, a database — through plain natural-language instructions.

agentic_systems.title: Real-Time Voice Agents
agentic_systems.description: Voice agents that answer inbound calls live — speech-to-text, real-time response streaming and WebSocket delivery — cutting wait times on busy support desks.

agentic_systems.title: Reliability Engineering
agentic_systems.description: Multi-provider failover, LangSmith tracing, and token/context optimisation keep agents available and affordable under real production load.

agentic_systems.title: Enterprise & ERP Integration
agentic_systems.description: Custom Odoo ERP addons and sync pipelines that connect AI tools and dashboards to the systems a business already runs — securely, without disrupting daily operations.

items.title: AI & Automation Executive
items.summary: Own AI and automation for the business end to end — architecture, build and production ownership of commerce, ERP, voice and AI tooling that management, finance and support teams depend on daily.
details: Built a multi-store commerce platform (NestJS, Astro) with a Shopify-style merchant dashboard, now running 3 stores from a single admin across products, inventory, orders, fulfilment and delivery.
Added an AI layer to the platform: an AI chat assistant and AI helpdesk for customers, plus an MCP server that lets admin users make any store change through natural-language instructions.
Delivered OdooGPT, an AI agent inside Odoo ERP that lets the management team query sales, stock and finance data and complete tasks in plain language.
Deployed a real-time AI voice agent for the customer help desk that answers inbound calls, understands requests and responds live, reducing wait times and load on support staff.
Integrated Amazon fulfilment and multiple delivery partners, and built the delivery logistics that takes every order from checkout to the customer's door.

Integrated Odoo ERP as the platform's operational backbone, with 10+ custom addons that securely sync ERP data to external systems, and added self-hosted Rybbit analytics and Raven team messaging, deployed and operated on Elestio.
Built a full-stack AI analyst web app (Astro) that answers management and finance questions on sales, finance and operations data.
Automated email handling with an LLM pipeline that classifies incoming mail, drafts replies and routes requests to the right team.

items.title: AI Engineer – Python Backend
items.summary: Designed and deployed production AI agents and a multi-LLM orchestration layer for an Abu Dhabi government entity and a subscription-based generative content platform.
details: Delivered two production AI agents for an Abu Dhabi government entity, with RAG knowledge bases that re-index updated documents automatically and multi-provider failover that keeps the service available during model or API outages.

Architected a multi-LLM orchestration layer connecting OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini and other providers behind one API, with model switching, fallback handling, centralised tool execution and message compaction that removed context-overflow errors and lowered token costs.
Built real-time response streaming with Redis pub/sub and caching, reducing duplicate model calls and response latency under high concurrency.
Shipped generative content tools (script, voiceover, image and video) for a subscription UGC platform, built on Replicate, HuggingFace, OpenAI, StabilityAI (SDXL) and Fal.ai.
Built LangChain RAG agents and knowledge assistants, automated business processes with n8n and webhooks, and deployed AI microservices with FastAPI / Flask on AWS.
